lineClean: A model estate, and this time the papers mean it.
lineDirty: Same banner, same ceremony. Someone at the Ministry was persuaded.
lineReboisasi: More of the land went back to forest than ever went to palms.
lineFade: Survived every season, never certified. The first palms are too tall to harvest.
lineBanned: The operating ban outlasted the cash.
lineArrested: The fires were set on purpose, and the letters were ignored.
reboisasiQuote: You chose the world over your own desire. You are a true noble. If most people would do the same, if government would support such a path, the world could have been a better place.
presidentLabel: The President, at the Kopdes door
presidentQuote: Your palm trees will do the country a favour.
tryAgain: Try again from an earlier year
sameSeed: Same seed, same weather ahead; different decisions.
lineRedemption: You lit it, and then you spent years putting it back.
redemptionQuote: You burned this forest, and then you gave it back, hectare by hectare, and took nothing out of the ground you cleared. The land keeps no grudge and sends no thanks. It simply grows again, which is the only apology it accepts.
